checks.name: Plan can be prepared without an AI request, including a tentative stop
Reload and a new scene do not erase the explicit trip intention
Done and skipped steps advance while preserving final destination and uncertainty
Completion ends context; explicit previous-step action can undo it
Pausing and clearing withhold the plan immediately
A plan expires after a day without becoming a permanent learner fact
Steps are bounded; other learners have no inherited plan
AI steps remain a draft until accepted; late suggestions cannot replace an edit
